Meta.description: Plan trips together, day by day, in real time.

Landing.title: Plan the trip together
Landing.body: Build the itinerary day by day with your group and see every change as it happens.
Landing.imageAlt: A day in Belo Horizonte on TripForge: the list of stops on the left and, on the map, the way between them following the streets.
Landing.f1b: Changes show up on every screen as they happen, with who is here and what they are working on.
Landing.f2b: Distance and time by street, on foot or by car, and a warning when there is no time to get there.
Landing.f3b: What you change offline is kept and sent later. If someone changed the same thing, you choose.
Landing.credit: Map © OpenMapTiles and OpenFreeMap, data from OpenStreetMap. Routes: OSRM, FOSSGIS. Relief: Mapzen, NASA SRTM.
Landing.p2b: Search for a name and it lands on the map, in the order of the day.
Landing.p3b: Real distance and time between stops, on foot or by car. This one is 15 km across Belo Horizonte.
Landing.p4b: You move a stop and Ana sees it at once, on her phone.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: TripForge is a small, free project with no ads, no tracking and nothing for sale.

kept.title: What is kept
kept.body: Your name, your email, a scrambled form of your password, and what you put in your trips: places, times, notes, comments, expenses, lists and files. While you are signed in, also your device's browser name and internet address, for your safety.

seen.title: Who sees it
seen.body: Only the people on each trip. Bookings, files, comments, votes, expenses and lists are only for those who can edit it. Whoever has a view link sees the itinerary, the map and the notes, and nobody's name.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Two, both needed: one keeps you signed in, and the other remembers your language. What you change without a connection waits in your browser until it can be sent.

others.title: Other services
others.body: The map comes to your browser straight from OpenFreeMap, and the relief from Amazon's open data, so they see your internet address. Place searches go to Photon, routes to OSRM at FOSSGIS and forecasts to MET Norway, always through our server: they see places, never who you are. The site runs on a server in Brazil.

backups.title: Copies
backups.body: The database is copied every day, and each copy is deleted after about two weeks. Something you delete can still be in them until then.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: In your account you can change your name, download your data and delete everything. Links can be revoked at any time on the trip's people page.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Write to whoever runs this site <link>on the project's page</link>. Do not put personal data there: it is public.
